content.description: The text content of the post

media.description: File paths of images or videos to attach. Upload media first using the "Upload File from URL" action, then paste the returned path here.

shortLink.description: Automatically shorten URLs in the post content

settings.description: Optional platform-specific settings (e.g. approval workflow overrides)

aiMetadata.description: Publishes content to a connected social channel in one of three modes selectable via the post type: publish immediately, schedule for a future date, or save as a draft. Use to push a message out through Postiz; a publish date is required when scheduling, and media must be a path returned by the Upload File from URL action. Not idempotent — each call creates a new post.

list_posts.name: list_posts
list_posts.description: Retrieve posts within a date range

startDate.description: Start of the date range (ISO 8601 format)

endDate.description: End of the date range (ISO 8601 format)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves posts scheduled or published within a given date range across all connected channels. Use to inspect what is on the calendar or to obtain post IDs for analytics or deletion. Both start and end dates are required. Idempotent — a read-only lookup.

delete_post.name: delete_post
delete_post.description: Delete a post and all other posts in the same group

postId.description: The ID of the post to delete. You can get this from the "List Posts" or "New Published Post" trigger output.

aiMetadata.description: Deletes a post by its ID, along with every other post in the same group (a post fanned out to multiple channels). Use to cancel or remove a scheduled or published post. Requires a post ID, obtainable from List Posts or the New Published Post trigger. Effectively idempotent — re-deleting an already-removed post has no further effect.

list_integrations.name: list_integrations
list_integrations.description: List all connected social media channels in your organization

aiMetadata.description: Lists every social media channel connected to the organization, returning each channel id, name, and provider. Use to discover which channels are available and to resolve the integration id required by Create Post, Find Available Slot, and Get Platform Analytics. Idempotent — a read-only lookup.

find_available_slot.name: find_available_slot
find_available_slot.description: Find the next available posting time slot for a connected channel

integration.description: Select the connected social media channel

base_url.description: The API base URL. Use `https://api.postiz.com/public/v1` for Postiz Cloud, or `https://your-domain.com/api/public/v1` for self-hosted instances.

api_key.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your Postiz dashboard
2. Go to **Settings > Developers > Public API**
3. Generate a new API key and copy it

aiMetadata.description: Returns the next free posting time slot for a connected channel based on its posting schedule. Use before scheduling to pick a non-conflicting publish date for Create Post. Requires the channel integration id (resolve via List Channels). Idempotent — a read-only lookup.

get_platform_analytics.name: get_platform_analytics
get_platform_analytics.description: Retrieve analytics (followers, impressions, engagement) for a connected channel

integration.description: Select the connected social media channel

base_url.description: The API base URL. Use `https://api.postiz.com/public/v1` for Postiz Cloud, or `https://your-domain.com/api/public/v1` for self-hosted instances.

api_key.description:

days.description: Number of days to look back for analytics (e.g. 7, 30, 90)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves channel-level analytics (followers, impressions, engagement and their change) for a connected channel over a configurable lookback window in days. Use to report on overall account performance rather than a single post. Requires the channel integration id (resolve via List Channels). Idempotent — a read-only lookup.

get_post_analytics.name: get_post_analytics
get_post_analytics.description: Retrieve analytics (likes, comments, shares, impressions) for a specific published post

postId.description: The ID of the published post. You can get this from the "List Posts" or "New Published Post" trigger output.

days.description: Number of days to look back for analytics (e.g. 7, 30, 90)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves engagement analytics (likes, comments, shares, impressions and their change) for a single published post over a configurable lookback window in days. Use to measure how one specific post performed. Requires the post ID (from List Posts or the New Published Post trigger). Idempotent — a read-only lookup.

upload_file_from_url.name: upload_file_from_url
upload_file_from_url.description: Upload a media file from a URL to Postiz. Returns the file path to use when creating posts.

url.description: The public URL of the image or video to upload

aiMetadata.description: Downloads an image or video from a public URL and uploads it into Postiz media storage, returning a file path to attach to Create Post. Use this first whenever a post needs media. Requires a publicly reachable file URL. Not idempotent — each call uploads a new media file.
